description: Bangladesh Daily Electricity Demand, Generation and Load-Shedding Dataset (2016–2026), published by Mridha, Imran Kabir, reconstructs national and zonal Bangladesh electricity operations from BPDB and NLDC reports. Coverage: National daily reports for 19 October 2019 to 1 August 2026, nine-zone records reaching back to 2016, and selected plant and substation detail. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The deposit reports successful accounting-identity checks, but this review did not reproduce extraction or assess missing source reports. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
